description: Get trend and momentum for a commodity from its daily prices: trend direction and strength, RSI, 20-day SMA, support and resistance levels and a combined signal (type=analysis, the default), or one indicator series: sma, ema or rsi (dated values with the price), or levels (support, resistance, pivot, range and quartiles). Indicator types use at least 90 days of history. Use when the user asks about technical trend, momentum or support and resistance. These are computed indicators, not forecasts. Analytics are plan-gated: the API answers HTTP 403 when the account's plan does not include them. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

type.description: analysis (default), sma, ema, rsi or levels.

window.description: Indicator window in days for sma/ema (API default 20) or rsi (API default 14).

name: opa_get_price_trend
title: Get Price Trend
